summary: Prevent missing shell commands from becoming successful no-op completion

delivery.outcome: Reject absent, blank and non-string shell execution commands before claim/start/run/done; independently publish the complete queue revision including the prior LLM contract guard, verify its installed runtime, then activate bounded idle fleet lanes with preserved dependency/admission bindings and rollback.
nonGoals: No synthetic approval for manually merged PR #698
No changes to executor selection, explicit valid shell commands or LLM contracts
No blind status or lease reset and no loss of other actors work

architecture.decision: Reuse the existing missing-action block path; remove implicit true fallback and reject non-string or whitespace-only shell actions. Observe valid explicit no-op commands as deliberately declared actions. A fresh independent publication binds the resulting complete runtime.
architecture.rollback: Restore the exact prior protected runtime; preserve task notes, evidence and lease history.
